design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST (revision 5). Marisol Bautista's Monthly EFT plan bills her Florida owner term (Minimum Limits Liability, 9 violation points).
- On 2026-09-08 her brother was added as a rated driver (additional premium 159.02, not yet billed).
- On 2026-09-11 an SR-22 Owner-Operator certificate was filed on the term (filing fee 25.00, recorded on the filing ledger, not yet billed).
- Her 560.00 online payment of 2026-09-10 paid installment 3 and some ahead. She then closed that checking account, and the payment was returned on 2026-09-16 coded account_closed.
- The flat NSF fee (25.00) and late fee (10.00) were posted by the system.
On 2026-09-24 she calls only to stop the drafts and be billed each month. She does not know anything is owed. The move's rule waits on two record states:
- "A plan is moved off automatic draft only after the installment invoice that the payment most recently returned on it had paid is paid again in full." Invoice 3 is unpaid again after the return, so the agent must find the returned payment in the records and take the makeup.
- "The first invoice after the move is figured only after the plan carries the switch down payment the move requires, a payment recorded toward the first installment not yet invoiced and linked to no invoice." No such payment stands, so the agent takes the switch down payment.

SCOPE. Task 1 owns billing_ext_returned_draft_makeup (user), billing_ext_switch_down_payment (user) and billing_ext_direct_bill_switch (agent). Task 0 owns the draft notice (automatic-draft plans only) and the endorsement deposit. Under the Six-Pay plan, installment 4 (due 2026-10-14) has an invoice date of 2026-09-24, today. The move falls with 3 installments invoiced and 2 not, inside its window. The base revocation sentence is retired for this case by a scoped overwrite that restates it for every other customer.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Draw: 2 prerequisites, factor_counts [5, 5, 4].
- Root: the move with its first invoice. Two value_input, state-form edges: makeup (invoice 3 paid again; its advance becomes the credit the first invoice carries) and switch down payment (a payment recorded toward installment 4 with no invoice; it is taken off the premium spread again).
- An ordinary prepayment carries installment number 0 and cannot satisfy that wait.
- The leaves commute: the down payment is 153.88 before or after the makeup, and the makeup is 519.36 before or after the down payment.
- First invoice: without the makeup 490.87, without the down payment 186.04, with both 109.10.
- The persona names neither prerequisite; it names only the move.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
- Makeup and down payment: single_payment_cap, certified_method. The authorization sentence is retired for these two payments only, by sibling overwrites.
- Move: switch_target (EFT may move to Six-Pay; 0 of 2 used); authorization_on_file is not engaged (the move is away from a Monthly plan); one_invoice_per_installment; the revocation sentence is scoped.
- The customer has 1 return, within the Six-Pay entry gate.
- Payment application on Monthly EFT and Card Autopay owner plans (the draft notice's single overwrite, base restated for every other plan): what a payment leaves after past-due invoices, fees and the current invoice is held as a credit, which the first invoice after the move carries. Later invoices of the moved plan follow the base installment rule with the respread installment premium.

FACTOR CARD - makeup (519.36; all-baseline 595.00; per-factor baselines returned_payment_recollection 813.54, undraftable_account_advance 314.18, filing_status_advance 491.36, payment_plan_advance 491.36, returned_amount_advance 505.36).
- Re-collection: 209.18 instead of 560.00.
- Undraftable advance: +205.18.
- SR-22 the term backs: 5% of 560.00.
- Automatic-draft plan: 5%.
- Returned amount of at least 500: 2.5%.
- The fees (25.00 + 10.00) are plain.

FACTOR CARD - switch down payment (153.88; all-baseline 37.08; per-factor baselines down_basis_by_invoicing_progress 253.38, returned_payment_down_addition 133.36, violation_points_down_addition 133.36, liability_package_down_addition 133.36, garaging_state_down_addition 143.62).
- Basis: 3 invoiced and 2 not, so the percentage applies to the scheduled premium not yet invoiced, 410.34.
- Percentage: 20 + 5 (return within 90 days) + 5 (9 points) + 5 (Minimum Limits) + 2.5 (Florida) = 37.5.

FACTOR CARD - first invoice (109.10; all-baseline 0.00; per-factor baselines endorsement_respread_share 29.59, switched_plan_credit_carry 0.00, direct_bill_state_fee 112.10, filer_first_bill_advance 101.15).
- Respread: (410.34 - 153.88) / 2 = 128.23.
- Endorsement share: 159.02 / 2 = 79.51.
- Billed ahead for the SR-22 the term backs: 5% of 159.02 = 7.95.
- Credit: 275.18 > respread + 9.00 with 2 left, so half is carried, -137.59.
- Fee: Florida direct-bill fee 6.00 (company state schedule) + the recorded certificate fee 25.00 (plain).

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify -> find_billing_plans -> find_billing_invoices -> find_billing_transactions -> find_billing_authorizations -> find_auto_policies -> find_auto_policy_changes -> find_auto_premium_transactions -> find_fr_filings -> find_fr_filing_transactions -> unlock+call(user) authorize_makeup_payment_1af63ac0(invoice 3, returned payment, debit_card, 519.36) -> unlock+call(user) authorize_switch_down_payment_5d76e7dc(4, debit_card, 153.88) -> unlock+call switch_to_direct_bill_b1ddc0c4(1638, 4, 2026-10-14, 215.69, 31.00, -137.59, 109.10).

PERSONA. A receptionist who closed her old bank account. She asks only for a monthly bill instead of drafts and does not know anything is owed. She gives phone and DOB, and her ZIP or license only if needed. She pays every amount handed to her by debit card, declines other changes, and closes once the bill plan and her first bill are confirmed.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Bautista, 36, a dental office receptionist in Tampa, calling Cardinal Point from your car before work. You recently closed your old checking account when you switched banks, and that is the account your car insurance has been drafting each month. You do not want the company drafting a bank account any more: you would rather get a bill each month and pay it yourself, by card. You do not know whether anything is owed on your account right now. You start by giving your name and the phone number on the account, 8135551468. If they need another detail to confirm it is you, you give your date of birth, 1990-02-17; only if they still need more do you give your ZIP code, 33603, or the last four of your license, 1752. You do not remember your policy number. If the representative says something has to be paid first, you sigh, say you understand, and pay it; whenever they hand you a payment to authorize, you pay with the debit card from your new bank for exactly the amount they give you. If they offer anything else, such as a different due date, you say not today. Once they confirm you are on the bill plan and tell you what your first bill is, you thank them and end the call.

base_preconditions.condition: A plan is switched only to a plan listed in its plan_switch_targets.
A switch to a Monthly EFT or Monthly Card Autopay plan requires a recurring payment authorization signed by the customer at least authorization_lead_days calendar days before the next draft date.
A customer may also revoke a recurring authorization at any time; the plan then becomes the Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan for its remaining installments.
Only one installment invoice is issued per installment number of a plan.

edges.policy_source: A plan is moved off automatic draft only after the installment invoice that the payment most recently returned on it had paid is paid again in full.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The payment most recently returned (560.00 of 2026-09-10) had paid invoice 3; after the return the net payments against invoice 3 are 0.00 against a minimum due of 209.18.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The makeup posts 519.36 against invoice 3; invoice 3 is paid in full again and the plan holds a credit of 275.18.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two leaves commute: the switch down payment reads no payment (153.88 before and after the makeup) and the makeup reads the balance only for its cap, which neither order reaches (519.36 before and after the down payment); the move reads both and comes last.

Without the switch down payment the respread premium is 205.17 and the minimum due 186.04 instead of 109.10.
